proposed_widenings.name: magic_item spawned_creature mechanics component
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary deterministic mechanic is summoning and controlling a companion, but MagicItemMechanics cannot currently carry the existing spawned_creature family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental.

proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature catalog-ref stat block source
proposed_widenings.justification: The item names a published creature stat block rather than inlining a custom summoned-creature block, so an honest encoding needs a catalog reference instead of placeholder inline stats.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. Existing magic-item families can model recharge and action cost, but not a summon-and-command companion payload; the named Air Elemental stat block is also external to the item text.
